name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: E-commerce Growth, Conversion & Retention
summary: Growth and retention operator with 15+ years across e-commerce, MarTech, agency, and B2B SaaS, focused on the full customer journey from first click to repeat purchase. At Wix, contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. Diagnoses where funnels leak, from ad traffic quality to on-site conversion, and builds the lifecycle automation that brings customers back: 20+ SMS and email workflows covering onboarding, reactivation, no-show recovery, and reviews. Tracks results in GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Power BI and reads the data before acting on it.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads and improve click quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Built 20+ automated SMS and email lifecycle workflows covering onboarding nurture, long-term reactivation, no-show recovery, and review generation.
Build landing pages and conversion-focused copy, and run technical SEO audits with fixes implemented directly in the CMS.
Install Google Tag Manager on every site built and track funnel progression and ROI in GA4 and Power BI dashboards.
Run a free audit offer as a top-of-funnel motion: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Designed LinkedIn ad campaigns with A/B-tested setups, and produced landing pages, email sequences, and conversion-focused copy.
Advised clients on ad-spend budget planning and allocation.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners (~94% retention) by analyzing utilization data and stepping in on adoption gaps before they became churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance at a performance marketing agency and translated results into optimization recommendations.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retail businesses adding online storefronts as a second revenue line.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow effort, defining test structure and success criteria.
Led digital growth consultations on site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO to improve traffic and conversion.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
